title: Lamb Tagine with Xenial Flair
description: A traditional Moroccan-inspired tagine made with tender lamb, exotic spices, and a hint of xenial sweetness.

ingredients.name: Xenial spice blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Syrian sumac
ingredients.notes: Adds a tangy, slightly sour flavor

ingredients.name: Dried apricots
ingredients.notes: Serves as a sweet contrast to the savory lamb

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: For cooking the lamb and creating a rich sauce

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb shoulder on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the xenial spice blend, Syrian sumac, and dried apricots.
Stir to combine, then add the chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the lamb with two forks and serve with the rich sauce spooned over the top.
